meta.name: contract-addresses
meta.description: Verified contract addresses for Uniswap, Aave, Safe, USDC, ENS, Chainlink, Lido, Aerodrome, and more — across mainnet and major L2s. All verified on-chain via eth_getCode as of February 2026.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 获取主流 DeFi 协议的链上已验证合约地址
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果开发或调试以太坊应用时需要可靠的合约地址。
copy.tagline_en: Get verified on-chain contract addresses for major DeFi protocols
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you develop or debug Ethereum apps and need reliable contract addresses.

howto.what: 装上后,当你想查某个协议的合约地址时,Claude 会给出经过链上验证的地址,覆盖 Uniswap、Aave、Safe 等协议,以及主网和主要 Layer 2。地址标注验证时间(2026 年 2 月)。
howto.when: 当你提到“合约地址”,或询问某个协议在主网/L2 上的地址时触发。

say.text: Uniswap 在以太坊主网的合约地址是多少？
say.note: 返回该协议的已验证地址。

say.text: 给我 Aave 在 Arbitrum 上的合约地址。
查一下 USDC 在 Optimism 上的合约地址。
say.note: 返回 USDC 在该链的地址。

howto.what_en: When installed, it makes Claude return verified on-chain contract addresses for protocols like Uniswap, Aave, Safe, and more across mainnet and major L2s, with verification date (Feb 2026).
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention 'contract address' or ask for a protocol's address on mainnet/L2.

say_en.text: What's Uniswap's contract address on Ethereum mainnet?
Give me Aave's contract address on Arbitrum.
say_en.note: Returns the address on that chain.

say_en.text: Check USDC's contract address on Optimism.
say_en.note: Returns USDC's address on that chain.
